test_title: SSC GD Constable 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Feb, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The office of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner of India falls under which ministry?

options.text: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

solution:
The Correct answer is __**Ministry of Home Affairs**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Office of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner of India** operates under the jurisdiction of the **Ministry of Home Affairs**.
 
• This office is responsible for conducting the **decennial Census of India**, which is one of the largest administrative exercises in the world.
 
• The office was established under the provisions of the **Census Act, 1948**, a law enacted to regulate the census process in India.
 
• The Registrar General and Census Commissioner is also tasked with maintaining the **National Population Register (NPR)**.
 
• The Census provides critical **data and statistics** that help in policy formulation and implementation across various sectors, including education, health, housing, and employment.
 
• The office plays a significant role in gathering demographic, socio-economic, and cultural data which is vital for **nation-building** and planning.
 
• The **Ministry of Home Affairs** ensures coordination and supervision of this office's activities to achieve accuracy and efficiency in census operations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Ministry of Rural Development**__

 __
 
• The **Ministry of Rural Development** is responsible for promoting rural infrastructure, livelihood, and development programs in India.
 
• It oversees schemes such as the **Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)**, **Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY)**, and **National Rural Livelihood Mission (NRLM)**.
 
• This ministry focuses on addressing poverty and improving the living standards of people in rural areas.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Finance**__
 __
 
• The **Ministry of Finance** is responsible for managing the financial system of India, including the preparation and presentation of the **Union Budget**.
 
• It oversees departments like **Revenue, Expenditure, Economic Affairs**, and **Financial Services**.
 
• The ministry plays a key role in taxation, fiscal policy, and regulation of financial institutions.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Health and Family Welfare**__
 
 
• The **Ministry of Health and Family Welfare** is responsible for formulating and implementing health-related policies in India.
 
• It oversees programs related to **public health**, **medical education**, and **family welfare.**
 
• The ministry manages initiatives like **Ayushman Bharat**, **National Health Mission (NHM)**, and **Universal Immunization Program (UIP).**
